caption:
We’re excited to announce the winners of our Art Contest, held in honor of Kazakhstan’s Independence Day and the professional days of 2D and 3D artists!🎨

Our participants – talented young creatives from across Kazakhstan – met the challenge of showcasing their vision of the future of Kazakhstan, blending national culture, futurism, and innovation. Each submission is a testament to the incredible talent and creativity of Kazakhstan’s youth.

A heartfelt thank you to all participants for your courage, creativity, and energy. We wish you to keep improving and creating works that will inspire and surprise!💯🔥

Here are our winners in the 2D category:
🥇 Amanzhol Amanai
🥈 Asqar Nuraim
🥉 Zhumadilova Inkar

Our winners in 3D category:
🥇 Medet Babyr
🥈 Baitokova Aibota
🥉 Qazhyakpar Aibolat

We’re thrilled to announce that we plan to make this contest an annual tradition, aimed at supporting, showcasing, and developing the exceptional potential of Kazakhstan’s artists😍

The winners of each category will receive:
1st place: Apple iMac 24
2nd place: Wacom Cintiq 22
3rd place: Apple iPad Pro 2024 with stylus

Congratulations to our winners, and thank you once again to all participants! We’ll be reaching out to each finalist this week👏
